result.query:
SELECT TOP 20000 [GroupTypeName] AS [GroupTypeName], [GroupName] AS [GroupName], [Kön] AS [Kön], [Ålder] AS [Ålder], [Measurementperiodtype] AS [Measurementperiodtype], [Mätperiod] AS [Mätperiod], [MeasurementPeriodDate] AS [MeasurementPeriodDate] 
FROM (SELECT 
	  MBusinessKey
    ,Version
	  ,GroupKey
	  ,MTypeBusinessKey
    ,MTypeName as Namn_MåttTyp
	  ,MName as Namn_Mått
		,GroupTypeName
		,Indelning_typ_desc
		,Enhet
		,Kommun
		,Region
    ,GroupName
    ,MeasurementPeriod as Mätperiod
	  ,Measurementperiodtype
	  ,MeasurementPeriodDate
	  ,PeriodStartYear
	  ,PeriodStartQuarter
    ,IsLastPeriod
	  ,LastPeriodFilterFlag
    ,Age as Ålder
    ,Gender as Kön
  	,concat(GroupName, '; ', Age, '; ', Gender) as LegendBase
    ,ValueD0
	  ,ValueD1
	  ,Value as Värde
    ,ValueD3
    ,ValueD4
        ,ValueChar
    ,numerator as Täljare
	  ,denominator as Nämnare
	  ,cihigh as KI_HögreGräns
	  ,cilow as KI_LägreGräns
	  ,Quartile1 as Kvartil1
	  ,Quartile2 as Median
	  ,Quartile3 as Kvartil3
	  ,MinValue as MinVärde
	  ,Percentile10 as Percentil10
	  ,Percentile90 as Percentil90
	  ,MaxValue as MaxVärde
    ,DataGenerationDate
    ,Commentary as Kommentar
	FROM [semantic].[VAI_PS_Trends]
) AS virtual_table 
WHERE [MBusinessKey] IN (N'G022') AND [GroupTypeName] IN (N'Riket', N'Region') GROUP BY [GroupTypeName], [GroupName], [Kön], [Ålder], [Measurementperiodtype], [Mätperiod], [MeasurementPeriodDate];
